% MHD flux (x-direction)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A4_flux}
\mathbf{F}(\mathbf{U}) = \begin{pmatrix}\rho v_x\\ \rho v_x^2 + P^\star - B_x^2\\\rho v_x v_y - B_x B_y\\ \rho v_x v_z - B_x B_z\\v_x B_y - v_y B_x\\ v_x B_z - v_z B_x\\(E + P^\star)v_x - B_x(\mathbf{B}\cdot\mathbf{v})\end{pmatrix}
\end{equation}

% Contact (entropy) wave speed S_M
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A4_SM}
S_M = \frac{(S_R - v_{xR})\rho_R v_{xR} - (S_L - v_{xL})\rho_L v_{xL} - p^{\star}_{\text{tot},R} + p^{\star}_{\text{tot},L}}{(S_R - v_{xR})\rho_R - (S_L - v_{xL})\rho_L}
\end{equation}

% Star-region density (Miyoshi-Kusano Eq. 43)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A4_rho_star}
\rho^{\star}_K = \rho_K \,\frac{S_K - v_{xK}}{S_K - S_M},\quad K \in \{L, R\}
\end{equation}

% Star-region total pressure (common on both sides, MK Eq. 41)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A4_Ptot_star}
p^{\star}_{\text{tot}} = p^{\star}_{\text{tot},L} + \rho_L(S_L - v_{xL})(S_M - v_{xL}) = p^{\star}_{\text{tot},R} + \rho_R(S_R - v_{xR})(S_M - v_{xR})
\end{equation}

% Star-region transverse B (MK Eq. 44, 45)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A4_B_star}
B^{\star}_{yK} = B_{yK}\,\frac{\rho_K(S_K - v_{xK})^2 - B_x^{2}}{\rho_K(S_K - v_{xK})(S_K - S_M) - B_x^{2}},\quad \text{same form for } B^{\star}_{zK}.
\end{equation}

% Star-region transverse velocity (MK Eq. 46, 47)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A4_v_star}
v^{\star}_{yK} = v_{yK} - B_x B_{yK}\,\frac{S_M - v_{xK}}{\rho_K(S_K - v_{xK})(S_K - S_M) - B_x^{2}}
\end{equation}

% Alfvén wave speeds in star region (MK Eq. 51)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A4_S_Alfven}
S^{\star}_L = S_M - \frac{|B_x|}{\sqrt{\rho^{\star}_L}},\qquad S^{\star}_R = S_M + \frac{|B_x|}{\sqrt{\rho^{\star}_R}}
\end{equation}

% Double-star transverse velocity (MK Eq. 59, 60)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A4_vy_dstar}
v^{\star\star}_y = \frac{\sqrt{\rho^{\star}_L}\,v^{\star}_{yL} + \sqrt{\rho^{\star}_R}\,v^{\star}_{yR} + (B^{\star}_{yR} - B^{\star}_{yL})\,\mathrm{sign}(B_x)}{\sqrt{\rho^{\star}_L} + \sqrt{\rho^{\star}_R}}
\end{equation}

% Double-star transverse B (MK Eq. 61, 62)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A4_By_dstar}
B^{\star\star}_y = \frac{\sqrt{\rho^{\star}_L}\,B^{\star}_{yR} + \sqrt{\rho^{\star}_R}\,B^{\star}_{yL} + \sqrt{\rho^{\star}_L\rho^{\star}_R}\,(v^{\star}_{yR} - v^{\star}_{yL})\,\mathrm{sign}(B_x)}{\sqrt{\rho^{\star}_L} + \sqrt{\rho^{\star}_R}}
\end{equation}

% Star-region total energy (MK Eq. 48)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A4_E_star}
E^{\star}_K = \frac{(S_K - v_{xK})E_K - p^{\star}_{\text{tot},K} v_{xK} + p^{\star}_{\text{tot}} S_M + B_x(\mathbf{B}_K\cdot\mathbf{v}_K - \mathbf{B}^{\star}_K\cdot\mathbf{v}^{\star}_K)}{S_K - S_M}
\end{equation}

% Double-star total energy (MK Eq. 63)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A4_E_dstar}
E^{\star\star}_L = E^{\star}_L - \sqrt{\rho^{\star}_L}\left(\mathbf{B}^{\star}_L\cdot\mathbf{v}^{\star}_L - \mathbf{B}^{\star\star}\cdot\mathbf{v}^{\star\star}\right)\mathrm{sign}(B_x)
\end{equation}

% Outer-wave RH consistency (numerically verified)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A4_RH_outer}
\mathbf{F}(\mathbf{U}^{\star}_K) - \mathbf{F}(\mathbf{U}_K) = S_K\left(\mathbf{U}^{\star}_K - \mathbf{U}_K\right),\quad K \in \{L, R\}
\end{equation}
